description.narrative: Expected development impact outcomes include i) increased access to equity financing across emerging markets, addressing critical infrastructure needs and delivering increased access to quality infrastructure; and (ii) scaling private capital mobilization that supports emerging market infrastructure needs.

The proposed investment is for a commitment of up to US$100 million, along with a proposed co-investment envelope of US$75 million, in the Global Infrastructure Partners Emerging Markets Fund II (the Fund or EM II), a fund focusing on investments in infrastructure assets or business across four sectors: Energy, Transport, Digital and Water/Waste.
